printedSkills.text:
游戏开始时，你获得3枚“暴戾”标记(标记上限为3)。出牌阶段，你可以交给一名其他角色1枚“暴戾”标记，你对其造成的伤害+1，且其出牌阶段开始时移除“暴戾”标记并随机执行一项：
 1.受到1点火焰伤害且本回合不能使用【杀】指定你为目标；
 2.失去1点体力且本回合手牌上限-1；
 3.你随机获得其一张手牌和一张装备区里的牌。
锁定技，当其他角色进入濒死状态时，你获得1枚“暴戾”标记，然后若其需要超过一张【桃】或【酒】救回，你获得使其进入此濒死状态的牌。

implementationInterpretations: Pool/target public Baoli counts are capped at3; ownership attribution is retained in native marker source totals and immutable typed grants. A source spends its own sourced pool, not an unrelated source grant.

Repeated grants to the same target are not forbidden by an invented once-per-target clause. At that source/target actual Play start, all outstanding enabled-source grants are consumed together and exactly one native RNG outcome is frozen; different sources settle in native seat order. Damage bonus is +1 per actual enabled source relation, never per marker count. No dedicated official multi-source FAQ found.

New future damage boosts and unpaid phase callbacks require the original granted source instance enabled and its owner alive. Inactive/orphan marker grants are retained as existing physical state; no new effects are issued from a missing source. Paid phase/native-child receipts continue once through source loss/death. No official loss/death FAQ found; this is implementation interpretation.

A paid fire branch uses the actual marker source owner as native source; a paid HP branch has no invented damage source. Source attribution is an implementation interpretation where current printed text omits the explicit source phrase.

Native phase RNG uses one deterministic Next(3), yielding one of the printed three outcomes; uniform modulo sampling is the implementation interpretation, not a dedicated distribution FAQ. Random acquisition samples the real current opaque hand and current equipment separately; an empty region contributes zero.

Turn restrictions belong to the actual turn number/owner and are paid before child effects, expiring at true TurnEnded. Directed Slash use prohibition is not a Duel/Barbarian played-out Slash restriction.

ShaJue2023 captures the original rescue requirement from an exact owning DamageFrame scalar receipt before the native compatibility clamp: original HpBefore minus actual applied damage, then 1 minus that result. The existing engine still stores/clamps HP at zero; this proof does not claim stored HP was negative and does not rewrite old HP/replay behavior. At actual Dying entry the same damage owner/target/amount and latest actual DamageApplied fact are verified before freezing the requirement. Later rescue cannot change it. One-Peach dying replenishes too; heal-effectiveness-changing combinations remain not separately verified.

The causal native CardUse/held Lightning keeps its own frozen claim receipt so original card finish recognizes only that exact paid departed entity after the skill producer is retired. Pure skill/zero-material causes provide no cards. Already-moved/stolen material is not claimed again.
